title: Silver nanoparticles from metallic silver via electrochemical synthesis-polyol reduction
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,12009-12019
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00967G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Chenyi Zheng, Lianghong Duan, Songsong Wang, Qiang Wang, Qinmeng Wang, Xueyi Guo
Ag nanoparticles (NPs) are directly synthesized from Ag metal via the electrochemical synthesis-polyol reduction method, eliminating the need for Ag compounds. Nanowires and purified NPs are synthesized from pure and crude Ag, respectively.
